title: Declan Rice, Bukayo Saka and Noni Madueke leave England squad with Thomas Tuchel 'worried' about injured Arsenal star ahead of Japan clash
desc: England have been hit by a wave of high-profile withdrawals as Arsenal trio Declan Rice, Bukayo Saka, and Noni Madueke lead a group of eight players leaving the international camp. Thomas Tuchel confirmed the departures ahead of Tuesday's friendly against Japan, with the German manager admitting serious concern over the fitness of one particular Gunners star.

title: Canadian ice dancers Gilles, Poirier claim silver at worlds for 3rd straight year in potential swan song
desc: Piper Gilles and Paul Poirier are silver medallists once again at the world figure skating championships. The Canadian ice dancers reached the podium's second step for a third consecutive season Saturday, scoring 125.07 points to their "Wuthering Heights" routine for a total of 211.52. Gilles and Poirier also won bronze in 2021 and 2023.
